title: Minimum Number of Moves to Make Palindrome
description: Find the minimum number of swaps of adjacent characters to make the string a palindrome.
pseudocode:
1. Convert string to array S
2. While left < right:
3.   Find matching character from right side
4.   If no match, it is the center character, move to middle
5.   Else, swap matching character to the right position
6.   Accumulate swap count

steps.note: Pointers: left=0, right=3. S[0] is 'a'. Search for 'a' starting from right.
Match for S[0] found at index 1
Swap S[1] with S[2], then S[2] with S[3] to bring it to index 3
Swap S[2] with S[1] to finalize move
